summary: Verified the 'Technique & Positioning' feature card bug fix on the X-Ray Vault static marketing site. The watermark image is applied with opacity 0.10 and mix-blend-mode: multiply, and the card's THE CORE overline, H3 heading, and paragraph text are clearly legible with strong contrast. The rest of the Home page (hero, feature bento grid, footer) renders correctly with no layout breakage or console errors.

page_layout.title: X-Ray Vault — Secure radiography, in your pocket
page_layout.console_errors: none (only a benign net::ERR_FAILED from the intentionally blocked Lenis CDN request)

critical_code_review_comments: Bug fix is correctly applied: .card--feature img (opacity .1, mix-blend-mode multiply) + .card--feature::after scrim + .card--feature .in z-index 2 ensure text sits above the watermark with a light gradient backdrop.
Contrast ratios of the heading (#0F172A on ~white) and paragraph (#556170 on ~white) are well within WCAG AA.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static HTML/CSS site served via `serve` on the frontend URL. No backend. Lenis smooth-scroll CDN can interfere with programmatic scrolling — abort '**/lenis*' requests in Playwright, then use scroll_into_view_if_needed on the target element. Feature card lives at [data-testid='feature-technique'] inside section#security on index.html.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — bug already fixed; verification only.
